Host.TailscaleStatus: Devices on the same Tailscale account can connect to this Mac from any network; Tailscale relays when a direct path fails.
Host.TailscaleAdviceTitle: Want to reach this Mac from another network? Use Tailscale
Host.TailscaleAdvice: Install Tailscale on this Mac and the other device and sign in to the same account. Tailscale does hole punching and falls back to a relay, so you need no server of your own. You do not need it within a single local network.
Host.ListenEverywhere: All networks (recommended): reachable over the local network and Tailscale
Host.ListenOnOneHelp: Only this address accepts connections. Use 127.0.0.1 only for testing on this Mac.
Host.AddressesTitle: The other person can connect with any of these addresses
Host.RestartNeeded: The signaling server or local network visibility setting changed. Stop and start again to apply it.
Host.ConfirmNote: You see a confirmation window every time someone connects.
Host.NoAccessibility: This Mac has not granted the Accessibility permission: the other person can only watch, not use the keyboard and mouse.
Host.DropHint: Drop files here to send them to the other person · Received files go to {0}
Host.ListenEverywhereSummary: All networks (local network and Tailscale), port {0}
Host.HostingState: On: the other person enters any address below and the one-time code to request a connection, and you confirm each time
Host.StoppedState: Off: nobody can connect to this Mac
Host.BadListen: The listen address is not valid. Use IP:port, for example 192.168.1.20:47800.
Host.NeedScreenRecording: Give NexaDesk the Screen Recording permission first so others can see this Mac's screen.
Host.StartTimeout: The host service took too long to start.
Host.PolicyRefused: “Don't ask again when this device connects” can only be turned on when confirming a connection.
Host.LinkLost: Lost the connection to the host service. Remote control is now off.
Host.ExitScreenRecording: The host service cannot start without the Screen Recording permission.
Host.ExitCannotListen: Cannot listen on {0}: the address does not belong to this Mac, or the port is in use.
Host.ExitAlreadyRunning: Another host service is already running.
Host.ExitDeviceKey: Could not read this Mac's device key (Keychain).
Host.PermIntroHosting: To let others see and control this Mac, turn on the switches below for NexaDesk in System Settings → Privacy & Security.
Host.PermIntroViewing: To send every key, including Cmd+Tab, to the other device, turn on Accessibility for NexaDesk. You can control without it, but system shortcuts stay on this Mac.
Host.PermScreenRecordingUse: Screen Recording (required): lets the other person see your screen
Host.PermAccessibilityUseHosting: Accessibility: lets the other person use your keyboard and mouse; without it they can only watch
Host.PermAccessibilityUseViewing: Accessibility: captures every key while you control another device
Host.PermRestartNote: After you turn a switch on, macOS may ask you to quit and reopen NexaDesk before it takes effect.
Host.BrowserDetail: Open in a browser, nothing to install
